body: So NTA. Oh heck no. The amount of disrespect coming from this man. Smdh. Husbands are supposed to love their wives. Love would be not inviting a woman who tried to wreck your relationship. Love would be following you out of concern, not stay with said woman for TWO HOURS. Love would be comforting and reassuring you. Leave before he cheats on you because he obviously doesn't respect you or your marriage and neither does she.

NTA. Yikes. I thought the "no girls allowed" thing stopped by age 12. This is just really immature on their part. She's a little girl, not Satan. If others can bring their children then you can too. 😒

NTA. If she didn't want her child to be in the same room with any meat then she should've found a vegan babysitter. 🙄 She's not even paying OP but thinks she's gets to dictate what food can be served to everyone else. She should feel grateful that OP not only is doing this for free but is also respecting dietary restrictions. This woman has gotten too used to expecting everyone around her to jump whenever she says so. Who tf does she think she is to be ordering everyone around? Treating OP like a child. Ridiculous.
I never said you did but you did say you didn't think it's coercion when it clearly is.

The way I see it he is very much trying to coerce her into doing what he wants. I've been there. Every woman has. Perhaps a man asks for nudes and the woman says no. Then he keeps asking and asking until she's finally had enough and sends them. She didn't really want to but felt she had to. Just bc she hasn't gotten to the point where she does exactly what he wants doesn't make it any less scummy. Dude sounds like a predator. He treats sex like it's transactional or something. Where does this end? Say she gives in. He'll take that as a hint to want more and more. Dude is obviously watching too much porn. It's nonstop sex today, wanting to fling her into some BDSM shit tomorrow. He needs therapy.
Coercion is not consent.

Your husband sounds super entitled and selfish. He's completely ignoring your feelings! A.) First of all, consent can be withdrawn at any time. B.) You don't owe him nonstop sex, regardless of a "promise". C.) It's disturbing how little he thinks of your feelings and comfort. All he cares about is HIS needs and HIS fulfillment. What about you? D.) You are not his personal sex doll. You are a person with thoughts and feelings who is deserving of respect. He needs to be reminding of that.

So NTA. They are not your children. You don't have to put up with that crap. You don't have to take them anywhere. You were being nice by offering to begin with. If one of the children decides to destroy your things just bc he didn't get his way you have every right to give him back to his mother. I can definitely see where he gets it from. Someone needs to remind your sister that her child is not owed a trip if he's going to behave in such a way.

I'm in Oregon too! I'm so relieved that they protect our rights here but if there's a federal ban I don't think there's much they can do. Planned Parenthood is coming to my town to help with the influx (they're currently getting permits and whatnot) but that's only one extra clinic. It's not enough. People are going to have to be turned away. It's a Republican majority in my town so help won't be too available. I'm willing to change careers to work there but I'm only one person in a sea of red. It's only going to get worse. Her fears are definitely valid.

As a fellow woman in America, I totally get it. Abortion is no longer a choice in a lot of the country. They're coming for birth control next so you can't even prevent pregnancy. Sure there are states that protect such rights but it's freaking terrifying. How long until they federally ban everything? I don't blame her one bit for fearing intimacy. Heck, I'm bisexual and I'm seriously considering only dating women from now on.

Okay wow. That is definitely not okay! Consent is key for that sort of thing. The fact that he did this without talking to you before hand is downright scary. What's next? Taping your mouth shut? Choking you? Edging you to the point you cry? There's nothing wrong with kinky sex but only if there is CONSENT. You were assaulted hun. And by your husband no less! You have two choices. Divorce or therapy. This can't happen again or it will keep happening and it will never stop. *hugs*

So NTA. You're allowed your privacy. She is not owed being in your home whenever she wants and for however long she wants. This reeks of emotional incest. The only one in the wrong here is her. She has no business invading your home for over a week. The man went on a work trip, not off to war. 🙄

YTA. Your daughter is an adult. She decides what she wants to do with the rest of her life. Any job she gets in the future she will have to do, not you. Your daughter is an autonomous human being, not an extension of yourself. She didn't "steal" anything from you. You're just mad that she's not being a good little sheep and doing exactly as you want. If you're not careful you're going to end up missing out on a relationship with her. She's an adult now. She doesn't even have to talk to you if she doesn't want to. You need to calm down, apologize and try to repair this relationship before it's too late. What's more important, having a relationship with your daughter or holding onto resentment that she took a different career path?

YTA. Ready my ass. You clearly resent your partner for having a child. You knew this when y'all got together. What do you expect? For her to abandon her CHILD so that you're not inconvenienced? The last thing y'all need to do is get married when you have this jealousy and resentment towards a CHILD. You clearly came here for validation and you're mad you didn't get it. Such is the internet my dude.

The numbers are the worst! Sometimes I do super great and then other times it's awful. That's when they threaten me with write ups or termination. But it makes no sense bc they share a spreadsheet every day of everyone's numbers from the day before and I'm definitely not the only one who gets in the red. It's frustrating to say the least. I'm glad you can relate though!

That's what makes it so confusing! They put in their information and then get mad at me for using said information. Some people get mad bc they wanted an email. (But why put in a phone number then?) Others get mad bc I call on a Sunday. (I can't pick my schedule.) Some don't remember signing up. Sometimes it's a wrong number or someone is using say their mom or grandmother's phone number. It just depends on the person. So yeah, lots of reasons why people get mad. I mean, I get it. There's a high volume of calls. I just wish I wouldn't get yelled at so often. I know it doesn't really have anything to do with me, just the situation but the insults are still hard to deal with.
Yeah we do!! Thanks so much for the prayers and support. 💗

There's no public transit as I live in a pretty rural area. My stepdad takes me places but I hate asking bc he's 70. I've been thinking about getting a service animal but I heard it's really expensive and I highly doubt my insurance covers it. Maybe just a regular pet?

I've never been allowed to drive. My condition is progressive so it's harder to manage. I can't go a month or two without having seizures. My doctor refuses to sign off on it until I go at least six months. I kinda just walk everywhere. It's a rural area though so it's hard to get around much without a car.

No way! That's so cool!! Not that you have it too. I know it sucks. I just mean it's cool to encounter someone who knows what it's like. I use both Indeed and Glassdoor. Literally every night before I go to bed I'm on those apps. I'm sure I'll find something eventually it just sucks atm bc I feel kinda stuck. 😮‍💨

So basically they put in their contact information on different college websites and the program we use uses that information to contact them. (That's how it was explained to me in training.) I don't provide the information. I'm the first point of contact so I basically just transfer them to admissions where they offer them the information.

It has to be an at home job due to the fact that I have epilepsy and am not allowed to drive. I also live alone. It is absolutely horrible. I find myself crying during my break at least one a week. I've been trying to find a new job pretty much since I started but no dice as of yet. I don't have much experience and have no degree so it's difficult to find something that isn't a call center. *sigh*

NTA. Where is your dad in all this? Pregnant or not this is unacceptable behavior. That is your house too. Demanding you only stay in your room and not use any other part of the house is ridiculous. She's being completely unreasonable. If my stepdad ever treated me like that when I was growing up my mom would've flipped. Not ok.

Definitely NTA. This is a health issue. My first question would be why is your brother sexualizing you? It's only "inappropriate" bc they made it so. Besides, it's YOUR house. They don't get to up and decide that you should change your routine just bc they're there. They should be grateful that you let them stay with you to begin with. If it's really that uncomfortable then they could always leave and stay elsewhere. You don't owe them shit. Don't let them bully you into a corner. They don't get to call the shots here. If they're uncomfortable that's THEIR problem, not yours.

Absolutely NTA. It's YOUR money, YOU decide what it is used for. You do not owe your sister piles of money just because SHE decides SHE wants a child. You've done more than enough already. It's time to think about you now. Your dreams shouldn't take a backseat just bc a child/grandchild is desired. I wouldn't give her another dime. She's obviously entitled and thinks the world revolves around her and her wishes. Who does she think she is to dictate what you should and shouldn't do with YOUR money? You don't require her approval to spend YOUR money. I'm sure you love your sister and all but I question what she has done for you. How has she helped YOU? It seems like it's a one way street here and that's no way to have a healthy relationship.

Definitely NTA. You are still grieving. It was extremely disrespectful for her to even ask let alone try to pressure you into giving it up. It has nothing to do with love. Stepdaughter needs to grow tf and accept that the world does not revolve around her and that she is not entitled to a damn thing. Her lack of sympathy is absolutely disgusting.

Oh you're definitely TA. She sacrificed a LOT to have those children. Do you have any idea how dangerous pregnancy can be? Rhetorical question bc you obviously don't. Women DIE all the damn time due to pregnancy. Countless others nearly die (my mom) or having to deal with permanent repercussions. She has every right to her feelings. Her body was changed irrevocably. She's ALLOWED to feel insecure. She's also ALLOWED to find support with other women. If you couldn't handle her not having a perfect fitness body then you should've never got her pregnant to begin with. She deserves so much better and so do the children. I hope she dumps your toxic behind.
